prompt: Write a single, self-contained prompt for a text-to-image model that has never heard of Chinese memes, so that it draws a cat version of the "大笑奶龙" (Laughing Nailong / 奶蛙) meme. Output only the prompt.
answer: Create a square reaction meme in soft, toy-like 3D. A plump, butter-yellow kitten throws its head back in an uncontrollable belly laugh. Give it an oversized, slightly flattened round head, tiny triangular ears, a cream belly, and little front paws tucked against its chest. Frame it tightly from the chest up, with its face turned slightly to one side. Its cheeks bunch up until its eyes squeeze into two thin curved slits. Its mouth opens into an absurdly wide, deep maroon oval that takes up most of the lower face, with a smooth row of rounded white upper teeth and a big pink tongue at the bottom. Tilt the chin up and hunch the shoulders so the whole body looks like it’s shaking with laughter. Use smooth, rubbery surfaces, warm diffuse light, and a plain pale background. Make the expression goofy, gleeful, and instantly readable at sticker size. No text, borders, or extra objects.
